title: HardcoreAbilities
description: HardcoreAbilities is a UHC+ and Hardcore Deluxe add-on that adds more abilities.
body:
---

## 🧠 What is HCA?

**Hardcore Abilities (HCA)** is a powerful RPG-style Minecraft plugin that transforms your server into a **progression-based hardcore experience**.

Unlock abilities, upgrade through skill trees, fuse powers, and climb ranks that make you **physically stronger** in-game.


---

## ⚔️ Features

### 🧬 Abilities System
- Unique active & passive abilities  
- Custom effects, scaling, and cooldowns  
- Designed for both PvP and survival  

---

### 🌳 Skill Trees
- Multiple upgrade paths  
- Click-to-unlock GUI system  
- Specialize your build (PvP, Tank, Mobility, etc.)  

---

### 🔥 Ability Fusion
- Combine abilities into stronger forms  
- Discover hidden and overpowered combos  
- Endgame progression system  

---

### 🏆 Ranked SMP System
Ranks give **REAL power boosts**:

- ❤️ Extra hearts  
- 🎒 Expanded inventory (`/extrainv`)  
- ⚔️ Increased attack damage  

**Example:**
- Rank 1 → +20 hearts + Double chest inventory + Damage boost  
- Higher ranks = even more insane buffs  

---

### 🖱️ GUI System
- Clean and modern menus  
- Click to unlock abilities & upgrades  
- Smooth and intuitive navigation  

---

### 💀 Hardcore Gameplay
- High-risk, high-reward mechanics  
- Designed for competitive SMPs  
- Death and progression actually matter  

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- **Server Software:** Paper, Spigot, Folia, Pufferfish  
- **Minecraft Versions:** 1.21 → 26.1+  
- **Performance:** Optimized ⚡  

---

## 📜 Commands

```
/hca
/abilities
/skills
/rank
/extrainv
```

---

## 🔐 Permissions

```
hca.use
hca.admin
hca.rankup
```

---

## 🎮 Perfect For

- Hardcore SMP servers  
- PvP servers  
- RPG progression servers  
- Content creators  

---

## 🚀 Why HCA?

HCA combines:
- Deep progression systems  
- Real stat scaling  
- Custom combat mechanics  
- Endless expansion potential
